description: Solar CapitalCost multiplied by 'factor' (KNOB, default 1.10) for all PWRSPV<node>, all 10 nodes, all years. Over the shared VRE-ceiling layer (expected not to bind: dearer solar -> less solar). To change the stress level before CPLEX, edit the single 'factor' value below.

edits.note: KNOB -- solar CAPEX multiplier. Default 1.10 (+10%). Edit this one number to rescale the shock; rides on top of per-node cost multipliers already in the A-O.
